---
title: Shipping service tiers
department: logistics
status: current
---
Northwind offers six service tiers. Every quote a sales team issues must name the
tier explicitly, because transit expectations and surcharges differ sharply
between them. A quote that says only "express" is not a valid quote and the
operations team will reject the booking at induction.

The table below is the authoritative reference. Where a customer contract
disagrees with this table, the contract wins only if the account manager has
recorded a written exception in the tariff system.

Service tier | Order cutoff (local) | Transit days | Fuel surcharge | Weekend pickup
Standard Ground | 18:00 | 4 to 6 | 4.5 percent | no
Economy Ground | 16:00 | 6 to 9 | 3.0 percent | no
Regional Express | 19:00 | 2 to 4 | 7.0 percent | yes
Freight Consolidated | 14:00 | 8 to 14 | 2.0 percent | no
Same Day Courier | 11:00 | same day | 22.0 percent | yes
Priority Air | 20:00 | 2 to 3 | 9.5 percent | yes

Fuel surcharges are recalculated on the first business day of each month against
the published diesel index. The percentage shown is applied to the base rate
only; it is never applied to accessorial charges such as liftgate service,
residential delivery or a second delivery attempt.

Transit days count business days in the destination country and exclude the day
of pickup. A shipment tendered after the order cutoff is treated as tendered on
the following business day, which is the single most common source of a
perceived transit delay. Before raising an incident for a late shipment, the
support team should confirm the tender timestamp against the cutoff above.
